feedback.problem:
What is the minor of ${t}_{22}$ in the matrix
$T=[\begin{aligned}3p & r & 3p \\ q & r & -q \\ -6q & -p & 6q\end{aligned}]?$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we remove the second row and the second column:

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}3p & ∗ & 3p \\ ∗ & r & ∗ \\ -6q & ∗ & 6q\end{aligned}]
$$

 

Next, we calculate the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det[\begin{aligned}3p & 3p \\ -6q & 6q\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}3p & 3p \\ -6q & 6q\end{aligned}| \\  & =3p\cdot 6q-3p\cdot (-6q) \\  & =18pq+18pq \\  & =36pq\end{aligned}
$$
